search.description: How a search groups the tasks it finds.

groups.description: A group, in order: a result goes to the first group whose view holds it. A user's list replaces the whole list.

view.description: The view of views.toml whose tasks the group holds. Required.

limit.description: The most results a group shows; its count counts them all.

other.description: The label of the last group, which holds what no group's view holds.

additionalProperties.description: One verb: its words and one target, action or verb, with op when nothing is named.

action.description: The catalog action it runs on each unit named.

op.description: What it runs on the text when it names no unit or task.

verb.description: The task verb of tasks.toml it runs on each task named; never one that resolves a gate.

words.description: The words that name the verb in every language, in one list, such as ["review", "revisar"]: vocabulary, not a text a locale translates. Required.

verbs.description: The verbs the omnibox knows, by id: typed first, a verb's word runs its target on what the rest names. No operation runs, from a verb or from the agent, that no verb targets.
